definitions.explanation: The highest or most intense degree of something. Used to express that something has reached its absolute limit or pinnacle.

examples.japanese: {感動|かんどう}の{極|きわ}みだ。
examples.english: It is the height of emotion.

examples.japanese: {失礼|しつれい}の{極|きわ}みとしか{言|い}いようがない。
examples.english: It can only be described as the height of rudeness.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{努力|どりょく}の{末|すえ}、{技術|ぎじゅつ}の{極|きわ}みに{達|たっ}した{職人|しょくにん}の{作品|さくひん}だ。
examples.english: This is the work of a craftsman who reached the pinnacle of skill after years of effort.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the pattern 〜の{極|きわ}み (the height/extreme of ~). Common combinations include {感動|かんどう}の{極|きわ}み (the height of emotion), {失礼|しつれい}の{極|きわ}み (the height of rudeness), and {贅沢|ぜいたく}の{極|きわ}み (the height of luxury). The expression {恐縮|きょうしゅく}の{極|きわ}み is a very formal, humble way to express deep gratitude or apology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感動|かんどう}の{極|きわ}み: the height of emotion
- {失礼|しつれい}の{極|きわ}み: the height of rudeness
- {贅沢|ぜいたく}の{極|きわ}み: the ultimate luxury
- {恐縮|きょうしゅく}の{極|きわ}み: most humbly grateful (very formal)
